sentences.text: The Victorian Institute of Forensic Mental Health, known as Forensicare, reported on 2025–26, providing specialist mental health care at the intersection of health and justice.
Forensicare reported practical completion of construction for 82 new secure mental health beds at Thomas Embling Hospital.
sentences.section: Report from the Board Chair and Chief Executive

sentences.text: It reported that 19 men awaited hospital admission at 30 June 2026, with an average wait of 374 days.
sentences.section: Report from the Board Chair and Chief Executive

sentences.text: Forensicare reported a positive overall service experience for 65% of consumers, below its target of 80%.
sentences.section: Reporting against the Statement of Priorities - Part B

sentences.text: The institute reported 909 full-time equivalent active employees at 30 June 2026.

items.quote: Late in 2025, Forensicare achieved full compliance against the National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards.
